visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing glasses and a blue/grey patterned long-sleeve button-down shirt is seated at a light-colored, reflective table within an indoor setting. He holds a clear plastic cup in his right hand, positioned above four colorful dice (red and blue) lined up on the table surface. In the background, a large screen displays a colorful cartoon illustration and Japanese text, with gaming console boxes visible on the side shelving. (2) With a swift, fluid motion, the man sweeps the plastic cup across the table surface, successfully capturing all four dice inside. He continues to move the cup in a vigorous, rhythmic circular pattern against the tabletop to induce centrifugal force, maintaining a focused and calm facial expression while staring intently at his hand's movement. His left hand remains rested on the table for balance. (3) He abruptly stops the circular motion and lifts the clear plastic cup straight into the air, revealing that the four dice have been stacked into a perfect vertical column. He looks directly at the camera with a subtle, satisfied smirk while the background screen continues to display various animated graphics. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the entire sequence.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic music with a BPM of approximately 128 starts immediately, featuring a bright and repetitive synthesizer lead. As the man initiates movement, the sound of a plastic cup sliding rapidly across a hard table surface is clearly audible, creating a distinct scraping acoustic texture with moderate high-frequency content. No vocal speech is present. (2) The primary acoustic focus shifts to the dense, percussive rattling of multiple small objects inside the plastic cup. This sound is characterized by a high event density and a broad frequency spectrum, mimicking a rhythmic shaker instrument. The background music maintains its energetic beat, with a processed male vocal hitting a bright "ding" note in perfect synchronization with the rhythmic cycle. (3) A singular, sharp percussive thud signals the end of the physical movement. The dense rattling noise ceases instantly, leaving only the continuous high-energy synthesizer loop and the repeating vocal "ding" artifact. The mix exhibits a high signal-to-noise ratio, with the intended music and trick-related sounds clearly separated from the studio-clean background noise floor.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a skillful 'dice stacking' trick where the creator uses centrifugal force to stack dice vertically inside a cup. The high-tempo music and quick reveal aim to entertain and impress the viewer.
